summary: Early invoice generated for reserved dedicated capacity — charges applied mid-billing-cycle
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports an invoice for their Reserved Dedicated Capacity commitment was generated and posted on 2026-03-12, approximately two weeks before their usual month-end invoice. The invoice includes the full monthly commitment charge rather than being pro-rated for the partial period.

Impact: NimbleDocs reports this results in billing their finance system mid-cycle and causing cashflow and forecast mismatch. They say usage for the reserved pool did not ramp until 2026-03-15 and expected charges to align with standard billing cycle (month end). No model performance or serving issues reported.

Environment: Dedicated contract (monthly reserved capacity) in prod, region us-east. Customer org ID: org-nimble-2391 (provided by customer).

Steps to reproduce / timeline provided by customer:
1) 2026-03-01: Customer renewed monthly reserved capacity commitment via console; billing terms unchanged.
2) 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-11: No significant usage on reserved pool.
3) 2026-03-12 03:14 UTC: Invoice #INV-2026-03-12-NIMBLE generated and emailed to finance contact.
4) 2026-03-13: Customer noticed charge in accounting and opened this ticket.

Observed behavior: Full monthly commitment charge applied on 2026-03-12 invoice generation. Invoice line items show 'Reserved Capacity - Monthly Commitment' unit price and quantity = 1 month. There is no prorated line or credit for days remaining in the billing cycle.

Expected behavior: For mid-cycle changes / renewals or renewals processed early, system should either (A) prorate the charge to align with existing cycle, or (B) only invoice at the regular month-end billing run. Customer expects a pro-rated charge or a correction.

Customer-provided artifacts: Customer attached invoice PDF and screenshot of console showing "Next billing date: 2026-03-31" and renewal confirmation timestamp. They also included their finance contact email (acct-payable@nimbledocs.com).

Initial logs/metrics available: Billing activity log shows an automated invoice generation event at 2026-03-12 03:12 UTC triggered by billing-run-service v2.3.7. No error entries associated with that run. We see an associated internal event 'reserved_commitment_activate' at 2026-03-12 02:59 UTC for org-nimble-2391.

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis 1: Renewal flow created a new billing anchor that shifted invoice schedule to the activation date; system then generated full-month charge rather than pro-rate because renewal created a new billing period.
- Hypothesis 2: Edge case in billing-run-service where a reserved capacity activation within a certain window triggers immediate invoicing instead of scheduling month-end invoice.
- Early check: Accounting config for NimbleDocs shows 'billing_anchor: activation_date' which would explain immediate invoice behavior if renewal_create triggers anchor update. Need to confirm whether the renewal_create should have been queued until month-end.
- Related internal ticket INT-4120 notes a recent config change to allow immediate invoicing for trial-to-paid transitions; could be leaking into reserved capacity path.

Customer request: Refund or credit for the unexpected mid-cycle full charge and reissue an invoice pro-rated to month-end; they requested temporary hold on collections/automatic retries until resolved.

Next steps (assigned):
1) Billing team to confirm whether billing anchor was updated on renewal_create and whether that action was intended for reserved contracts (Rafael).
2) If anchor update is unintended, generate reversing credit memo and create corrected prorated invoice for 2026-03-31 end-of-cycle (Finance ops).
3) If configuration change caused behavior, open follow-up engineering task to separate trial-to-paid immediate invoicing path from reserved commitments (link to potential PR in related_github_prs).
4) Communicate interim hold on collections and ETA to customer finance contact.

Requested by customer: please include a clear note on the corrective credit memo referencing invoice INV-2026-03-12-NIMBLE so their AP team can match transactions.
